Clean contact grain lettering

Adapted from Sharon Basovich's Giats preview component:
src/components/dom/contact/SandTitle.jsx

The Giats portfolio is by Evangelos Giatsidis:
https://github.com/Giats2498/giats-portfolio
Copyright (c) 2025 Evangelos Giatsidis.

Seeded text particles and radial pointer repulsion follow the MIT-licensed
particle-field approach credited by that adaptation:
https://github.com/imfemambocus/portfolio/blob/main/src/particles/shaders.ts
Copyright (c) 2026 Isfaaq M. F. Emambocus.

This clean-site version retains a real, selectable HTML heading and uses a
bounded Canvas2D overlay. Its particle positions are sampled from the rendered
heading, with restrained spring displacement and static mobile/reduced-motion
fallbacks. It does not use the original site's WebGL renderer or visual assets.
